name: Andaz Xiamen
positioning: Modern Nanyang-style mansion designed by JID in Xiamen's Siming District, sharing its underground parking with The MixC Xiamen mall
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led city base in Xiamen's Siming District
Guests drawn to Nanyang design and Fujian tea culture

facts.text: The hotel is at 101 Hubin East Road in Xiamen's Siming District.
The hotel's underground parking area is shared with The MixC Xiamen mall.
Rooms feature natural textures and materials such as rattan-backed armchairs, woven bamboo wall paneling and timber louvers.
Deluxe king rooms include a study, a daybed by the window and a walk-in closet.
Pool View Premium rooms look across the pool, lake or city.
Suites include a Chinese tea set with locally sourced tea.
The Andaz Executive Suite is a high-floor suite with a separate living room, dining area, kitchenette and study.
Rooms have a complimentary minibar with nonalcoholic drinks and snacks.
The hotel has an outdoor pool.
The hotel has a fitness center.
The hotel has a Pool House that can host events such as weddings.
No. 101 is an all-day restaurant with a series of open kitchens showcasing live cooking.

highlights.text: Andaz Xiamen was created by JID, which was founded by the late Indonesian designer Jaya Ibrahim.
Andaz Xiamen is a modern Nanyang-style mansion that reflects the local culture of Xiamen as a famous hometown of overseas Chinese.
The Presidential Suite has panoramic views of Yundang Lake.
The Andaz Suite has a separate living room, a dining area and a bathroom with a circular tub.
At Andaz Lounge, tea and coffee masters brew pour-over coffee and Fujian tea.

considerations.text: The hotel recommends local mapping apps such as Gaode Map or Baidu Map, as international mapping apps may not be accurate in mainland China.
Pets are not allowed at Andaz Xiamen.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting may lack a traditional coastal resort atmosphere.
